title: I Have Searched And Searched, Seeking
summary: Restlessness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan
source.lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: I have searched and searched, seeking the Blessed Vision of His Darshan
evidence.turn: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
